planDetail.zone13: Zones 1–3, from a brisk walk up

planHint.zone13: WHO: 150–300 minutes a week. Zones 1–3, from 50% of your max heart rate, a brisk walk.
planHint.zone45: WHO: 75–150 minutes a week, or mix them with moderate minutes.
planHint.strength: Strength, weights, HIIT or calisthenics workouts. WHO: 2 or more days a week.
planHint.steps: Your daily average over the week. The benefit levels off around 8,000 to 10,000 steps a day (Paluch 2022).
planHint.consistency: Your sleep consistency over the last 7 nights. 80% and up is optimal.
planHint.sleepNeed: Nights you sleep the need Pulse sets for that night.

plan.title: Weekly plan
plan.whyBody: These are the habits Pulse Age scores. The defaults follow the WHO’s 150 moderate or 75 vigorous minutes and two strength days a week, about 8,000 steps a day, and a steady sleep schedule. A tick on a bar marks where an even pace would be by now.

settings.azmWeekHint: Fitbit counts moderate minutes once and vigorous or peak minutes twice.
settings.dailyBody: Each goal is a row on Strain that fills through the day. Clear a number to turn its goal off.
settings.weeklyBody: Active Zone Minutes add up Monday to Sunday, while the daily Active Zone Minutes goal is on.
settings.planBody: Weekly targets for the habits Pulse Age scores, Monday to Sunday, with a streak for every week you meet them. Clear a number to turn it off.
settings.planReset: Weekly plan reset to its defaults

sleepGoal.title: Sleep goal
sleepGoal.errorFormat: Whole hours, and minutes from 0 to 59
sleepGoal.body: What Sleep Performance, Sleep Need, Sleep Debt and Energy Bank aim at. Changing it rescores your history.
sleepGoal.estimate: The average sleep before your {{best}} best Recovery mornings of the last {{nights}}: {{duration}}.
sleepGoal.estimateEarly: The average sleep before your {{best}} best Recovery mornings of the last {{nights}}: {{duration}}. An early estimate: it firms up with 90 nights, 15 of them at Recovery 67 or more ({{high}} so far).
sleepGoal.notEnough: Not enough nights yet: the estimate needs nights with a Recovery score, one of them at 67 or more. Until then the goal stays as it is.
